meta.note: Council finance rules for Scottish councils, beside data/config/rules.json for English ones. The engine reads these; nothing in code restates them. Each rule cites the law that sets it.

band_ratios.note: Bands E to H were raised from 11/9, 13/9, 15/9 and 18/9 of Band D by SSI 2016/368 from April 2017.

others_band_ratios.note: Scottish Water's water and sewerage charges kept the older ratios when council tax's changed in 2017: its 2026/27 table on page 5 is Band D times these to the penny (Band H is twice Band D).

single_person_discount.note: Scottish Water's leaflet says the single occupancy discount applies to its charges too.

balanced_budget.tolerance_note: £5,000. The Scottish Government's returns are in £ thousands, so sums of rounded lines can differ by a few thousand pounds. Anything larger is shown as still to find or spare, never rounded to balanced.
